entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Lazare Hippolyte Carnot was a French politician. He was the younger brother of the founder of thermodynamics Sadi Carnot and the 
second son of the revolutionary politician and general Lazare Nicolas Marguerite Carnot, who also served in the government 
of Napoleon, as well as the father of French president Marie François Sadi Carnot.
